scope: Read-only diagnosis of repeated retries after five completed move pairs and a sixth human move
status: cause confirmed; repair not implemented or deployed

reproduction.method: Fresh isolated Codex thread; thread/compact/start; dummy credential and loopback HTTP fixture

cause: The gateway requires the complete seven-tool chess set for every Responses request. Codex local compaction legitimately sends tools: [], which is rejected before any upstream request. Retrying the same saved thread repeats required compaction and the rejection.
repair_requirements: Support a narrowly validated text-only compaction request while retaining model, reasoning, persona, budget and output bounds.
Keep ordinary chess requests restricted to their exact canonical seven-tool schemas.
Test compaction completion, restoration of normal tool requests and continuation of the same saved thread.
Persist sanitized gateway rejection codes to make future protocol failures diagnosable.
